behaviors.description: Supply an OCI remote from a local image collection without collection-ID matching.
behaviors.preconditions: Runtime installed; controlled empty HTTP OCI remote with no collection ID; independent local OCI image.
behaviors.expected: Dynamic image collection permits installation from OCI remote, with matching executable bytes and exact origin, despite remote containing no images.

behaviors.description: Enumerate sideload refs from a repository with its own collection ID.
behaviors.preconditions: App-only native collection repository linked in documented sideload-repos directory; signed remote advertises app and runtime.
behaviors.expected: ONLY_SIDELOADED returns the exact app identity and commit, excluding remote-only runtime.

behaviors.description: Enumerate typed unused and pinned refs with architecture filters.
behaviors.preconditions: App using runtime/SDK and an unpinned extension; separate unused runtime; native and foreign pinned runtimes.
behaviors.expected: Exact unused and pinned membership for unrestricted, native, foreign and absent architectures; every returned element is an installed ref.

behaviors.description: Observe installation monitor notifications for direct lifecycle changes.
behaviors.preconditions: New public monitor connected before each install, update and uninstall; runtime satisfied and remote selected before monitoring.
behaviors.expected: Each operation produces a changed notification while main context is serviced and the expected deployment outcome.

behaviors.description: Control retention of files used by a running app during uninstall.
behaviors.preconditions: Held-live independent app probe; an open descriptor identifies its deployment across directory renames.
behaviors.expected: Both uninstalls remove installed identity; ordinary uninstall retains running files, force_uninstall removes them; process is killed and reaped.

behaviors.description: Install a bundle with the deprecated direct API.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent unsigned app bundle and already installed runtime.
behaviors.expected: Returned and queried identity/commit match exported input; repeat yields ALREADY_INSTALLED without changing deployment.

behaviors.description: Reject malformed and missing public bundle files.
behaviors.preconditions: Literal invalid bytes and nonexistent path; unrelated runtime installed.
behaviors.expected: Bundle constructor and direct installer fail with GError; transaction fails either when adding or running; app remains absent and runtime unchanged.

behaviors.description: Install signed bundles with explicit and embedded verification keys.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent signed bundle; runtime satisfied; prior bundle origin removed between installations.
behaviors.expected: Both transaction key modes deploy exact signed input commit.

behaviors.description: Install and replace local OCI images through the public transaction API.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A/B images of one app; runtime already installed; second transaction explicitly enables reinstall.
behaviors.expected: Each deployed executable matches corresponding independent bytes; first creates an origin, second reuses it without adding a remote.

behaviors.description: Restrict remote enumeration to sideload-available refs.
behaviors.preconditions: Signed remote advertises app and runtime; configured sideload repository holds app only.
behaviors.expected: ONLY_SIDELOADED returns exactly the app and independently recorded collection commit.

behaviors.description: Obtain app payload from a dynamically added sideload repository.
behaviors.preconditions: Signed HTTP remote and matching independently prepared sideload repo; runtime installed, app absent; remote payloads denied during transaction.
behaviors.expected: Transaction deploys exact signed app commit and makes no remote payload requests.

behaviors.description: Read release and rating fields from actual deployed AppStream.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent rich Query app and QuerySecond without optional AppStream fields.
behaviors.expected: Exact version, MIT license, oars-1.1 type and single violence-cartoon=none attribute; all optional getters NULL for second app.

behaviors.description: Read actual installed and remote end-of-life metadata.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent transaction A, EOL and REBASE commits.
behaviors.expected: Both typed refs expose absent, reason-only and reason-plus-full-rebase values matching independent exports.

behaviors.preconditions: CLI launches independent runtime probe and reports instance ID; probe confirms execution before inspection.
behaviors.expected: Exactly that live instance reports NULL app, expected runtime and runtime commit; sandbox is explicitly killed and reaped.

behaviors.description: Check public local-deployment outcomes after removing an undeployed ref.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent deployed app and second app; positive no-pull deployment control followed by uninstall and another pull-only operation.
behaviors.expected: Removing the deployed ref fails; removing the pulled-only ref succeeds and subsequent no-pull install fails; existing app and runtime commits remain intact. Object retention is not established.

behaviors.description: Check public deployment preservation across cleanup and pruning.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent deployed and pulled-only apps; positive no-pull deployment control for the second app before resetting it to pulled-only state.
behaviors.expected: Cleanup and prune succeed; no-pull install of the cleaned ref fails before and after pruning; deployed app and runtime commits stay intact. Orphaned-object deletion is not established.

behaviors.description: Defer and explicitly refresh exported MIME associations.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent desktop app A/B with different MIME types; desktop MIME trigger installed.
behaviors.expected: NO_TRIGGERS install/update/uninstall leaves cache unchanged until public run_triggers produces A/B/absent association respectively.

mappings.rationale: Independent local OCI collection supplies real deployed bytes for a collection-ID-free OCI remote whose controlled HTTP root has no images.
Native collection summary is checked independently of the USB mirror collection-map format; exact app singleton expected.
Typed results exclude the app, its used runtime/SDK and unpinned related extension; include only the separate unused runtime; pinned native/foreign refs and all architecture filters checked exactly.
Independent monitor registration immediately before each direct lifecycle operation, with context-driven event delivery and exact deployment checks.
Additional public force_uninstall contract has no exact row in the fixed denominator; held running files distinguish TRUE from FALSE.
Direct bundle success and repeat error are additional public checks; existing deprecated lifecycle obligation names different entry points.
Public bundle failure cases have no matching behavior row in the fixed denominator.
Signed independent bundle installed with embedded key and again with supplied key after removal of deployment and origin trust.
Direct image transactions deploy byte-distinct A/B executables and assert origin creation then reuse and exact remote count.
Complete remote has app/runtime; ONLY_SIDELOADED returns exact singleton app fixture commit from configured app-only repo.
Dynamic sideload API supplies exact signed app while controlled remote denies payloads; HTTP request history asserts none requested.
Real rich and field-absent deployments exercise all four typed getters including exact attribute membership and NULL cases.
Both typed installed and remote getters checked against independently exported absent, EOL-only and rebase metadata.
Synchronized actual runtime sandbox selected by launch-reported instance ID has NULL application getter.

Layout-independent partial check: deployed removal is rejected, no-pull installation stops working after undeployed removal, and existing commits survive. The full local-ref-protection obligation is withheld because object retention is unobserved.

Layout-independent partial check: cleanup and pruning preserve deployments and the cleaned ref cannot be installed without pulling. The orphaned-objects obligation is withheld because actual object reclamation is unobserved.
Install/update/uninstall NO_TRIGGERS observed against real exported desktop MIME cache; run_triggers must refresh each deferred change.
